description: Cybergenic is an open cancer genomics resource. Its scan tests which genes are mutated together or avoid each other in public tumour cohorts (196,184 burden-aware tests of 63,279 gene pairs from 24 cBioPortal studies, with false discovery correction), and it publishes pages for genes, single mutations and mutation classes, gene pairs, tumour types, copy number changes, gene fusions and 1,893 cancer cell lines, each built from its cited sources. Every test is downloadable as open data with DOIs, predictions are locked in a public hash-chained registry before they are tested, and Cell Line Check verifies cell line genotype labels. Results are for research, not clinical decisions.

download.note: Every gene pair the scan tested (196,184 tests in 59 cohorts) as Parquet with checksums and a column guide, plus fusion and copy-number frequency tables; CC BY-NC 4.0, with DOIs.

function.note: Tests gene co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity across public tumour cohorts with mutation-burden-aware statistics and false discovery correction, and shows per gene, mutation, gene pair, tumour type and cell line how often each change occurs and what it occurs with.

name: Cybergenic
